visual_differentiation_axes: split garden-and-stall workspace rather than full-screen crop grid
chalkboard revenue meter as the primary HUD motif
bottom workbench storage and shelf controls instead of generic command buttons
striped awning and paper price tags as screen motifs
produce crate launcher icon with price tag and awning backdrop
forbidden_visual_reuse: no generic orchard tree hero image
no flower basket icon like a flower boutique game
no animal pen or pasture HUD motif
no dark arcade or neon dashboard skin
no repeated top HUD pills plus bottom command strip as the central identity

ui_identity.layout_archetype: split garden-and-stall workspace with upper crop grid, lower market counter, left seed tray drawer, and chalkboard target meter
ui_identity.hud_composition: chalkboard revenue progress centered above the work area, day and time plaque on the left, reputation stamp hearts on the right, and a compact pause icon button
ui_identity.navigation_model: menu to day select, day select to active market day, day result to upgrade screen or next day, pause overlay during play
ui_identity.palette_signature: sky blue, leaf green, tomato red, carrot orange, cream paper, and warm light wood over skin_cartoon_light tokens
ui_identity.material_language: painted wood, paper price tags, chalkboard signs, cloth awning stripes, soft produce crates
ui_identity.typography_style: rounded friendly sans-serif with large numeric price and revenue values

playfield_safety.frame_overlay_policy: decorative awning and wooden trim must be structural reserved-edge art only and must not cover touch-critical plot, shelf, or customer regions

forbidden_ui_elements: generic floating rounded HUD pills for every stat
bottom-only command strip unrelated to the stall workbench
heavy frame overlay on active crop plots

icon_identity.subject: smiling wooden market crate overflowing with carrots, tomatoes, corn, and a small price tag
icon_identity.silhouette: large crate base, diagonal price tag, rounded produce cluster, and small awning triangle behind it
icon_identity.composition: foreground crate centered, produce rising above the rim, price tag angled on the right, awning arc in the background
icon_identity.palette: fresh green, tomato red, carrot orange, warm wood brown, cream tag, and sky blue background
icon_identity.background: simple bright sky-blue rounded square with a subtle striped awning shape
icon_identity.game_specific_motif: visible price tag connects the icon to live market selling rather than generic farming
